appStore.reviewNotes: 拾词 Lexa is a fully-offline English vocabulary trainer for non-native speakers, built on authoritative US learning materials. No account or sign-in is required — every feature works on first launch with no network connection. Purpose: study English words with flashcards and spaced repetition. How to test: on the home screen tap 开始学习 (Start Studying), a flashcard appears with the word and phonetic; tap the card to flip it and see the English definition, Chinese gloss, part of speech, word forms, and example sentences with Chinese translations (tap an example to hear it spoken); answer with 认识 (Know) or 不认识 (Don't Know) — correct answers schedule longer review intervals (Leitner boxes, 10 minutes up to 32 days). The 词库 (Word Bank) tab lists all 7,091 words across six books (plus an exam-collection aggregate view) with search; the 设置 (Settings) tab adjusts daily new-word quota (5–100), auto-pronunciation, and an optional daily study reminder (local notification). Words are pronounced with the system TTS voice. External services: none — no network calls, no analytics, no third-party SDKs; word data ships inside the app bundle. Regional differences: none — identical behavior in all regions. Word data sources: VOA Learning English Word Book (US government work, public domain), Academic Word List (© Averil Coxhead, free for teaching), ECDICT (MIT license); attribution is also shown in-app under 设置.

zh-Hans.fullDescription:
拾词 Lexa 是一款为非母语学习者设计的英语背单词应用。词库取自美国官方与权威学术材料，配合科学的记忆算法，帮助你高效、持久地扩大词汇量。

【权威词库 · 7091 词】
• VOA 核心词汇（1533 词）：源自"美国之音"VOA Learning English 官方 Word Book，覆盖最常用的英语核心表达，适合初学者打基础；
• AWL 学术词汇（570 词）：Academic Word List，北美大学英语教学广泛使用的学术词族，是阅读学术文章、备考托福的必备词汇；
• 四级核心词汇（1809 词）与六级核心词汇（1672 词）：覆盖四六级考试词表；
• 考研核心词汇（307 词）：考研词表去重精选，另有"考试合集"一键聚合学习；
• 托福雅思进阶词汇（1200 词）：按语料库词频精选的考试进阶词，适合四六级以上水平提升。

【科学记忆】
采用 Leitner 间隔重复算法：答对自动进入下一复习阶段，答错立即回炉，复习间隔从 10 分钟到 32 天逐级拉长。你只需要每天打开 App，剩下的交给算法。

【核心功能】
• 卡片式学习：正面记单词，翻面查看释义、词形变化与中英对照例句（例句可点读），"认识 / 不认识"或左右滑动作答，答错的词当场重现；
• 生词本：学习时一键收藏难词，集中练习；
• 标准美音发音：每个单词自动朗读（可关闭），边听边记；
• 词库浏览与搜索：按词书切换，随时查看音标、英文释义和中文释义；
• 每日目标：自定义每日新词数量，连续打卡记录，见证积累；
• 学习统计：已学、已掌握、待复习一目了然；
• 完全离线：词库内置于应用，进度保存在本地，无需注册登录，无广告、无内购。

【适合人群】
英语初学者、四六级考生、托福雅思备考者、想系统提升词汇量的英语学习者。

— 拾词的独特之处 —
• 词库即权威：VOA 官方词书（公有领域）+ AWL 学术词表 + ECDICT 词典数据（MIT），六本词书与考试合集共 7091 词，来源与授权透明，应用内可查；
• 每个词都有语境：音标、中英释义与词形变化之外，还有精选例句与中文对照，目标词含屈折形式高亮，可点读发音；
• 记忆交给算法：Leitner 间隔重复，答对自动拉长间隔，答错当场回炉，复习间隔从 10 分钟到 32 天逐级拉长；
• 隐私即默认：无账号、无广告、无内购、不联网、不收集任何数据，进度只存在你的设备上。

— 定价 —
全部内容开箱即用：六本词书、考试合集与所有功能均包含在应用内，无内购、无订阅、无广告。

— 反馈 —
由独立开发者开发。反馈、bug 报告或功能建议，欢迎发邮件至 obeliskclubclub@gmail.com。

服务条款（EULA）：https://obelisk.club/lexa/terms

en.name: Lexa: Vocabulary Trainer
en.subtitle: VOA & AWL words, offline
en.whatsNew: First App Store release: six word books with 7,091 words, exam collections, bilingual example sentences, swipe-to-study gestures, daily reminders and a 12-week study calendar.
en.fullDescription:
Lexa is a fully-offline English vocabulary trainer built on authoritative source materials, with a spaced-repetition engine that plans your reviews for you.

【Authoritative Word Books · 7,091 Words】
• VOA Core Vocabulary (1,533 words): from the official VOA Learning English Word Book, a US government work in the public domain
• Academic Word List (570 word families): Averil Coxhead's AWL, the standard for academic English reading
• CET-4 (1,809) and CET-6 (1,672) core words, plus a 307-word postgraduate exam set
• TOEFL/IELTS advanced vocabulary (1,200 words) selected by corpus frequency
• Exam Collection: one tap aggregates the exam books into a single deck

【Scientific Memory】
A Leitner box scheduler moves words to longer intervals when you know them and re-queues mistakes within the same session. Review gaps stretch from 10 minutes to 32 days; you just show up daily.

【Core Features】
• Flashcard study: flip a card for phonetics, definitions, word forms and bilingual example sentences (tap to hear them spoken)
• Answer with Know / Don't Know buttons or swipe gestures; wrong words come back before you finish
• Favorites: star difficult words and drill them in a dedicated session
• Pronunciation through the system voice, with optional auto-speak on every new card
• Word bank browsing and search across all books
• Daily goal, streak tracking and a 12-week study calendar

— WHAT MAKES LEXA DIFFERENT —
• Authoritative by construction: the VOA Word Book (public domain), the Academic Word List and ECDICT dictionary data (MIT), with sources and licenses disclosed in-app
• Context with every word: curated example sentences with Chinese translations and inflected-form highlighting, not just definitions
• Private by default: no account, no ads, no tracking, no network. Your progress never leaves your device.

— PRICING —
Everything ships with the app: all six word books, the exam collection and every feature are included, with no in-app purchases, no subscription and no ads.

— FEEDBACK —
Built by an independent developer. Questions, bug reports or feature requests are welcome at obeliskclubclub@gmail.com.

Terms of Service (EULA): https://obelisk.club/lexa/terms
